evals.prompt: 对这个项目做一次全面扫雷，预算充足，大水漫灌。
evals.expected_output: Infers the Exhaustive budget envelope, runs the lightweight flow probe, maps all release-critical flows, generates high-value failure scenarios, and adaptively selects evidence weapons from Git/memory, state, fault, variant, supply-chain, mutation, fuzzing, or trend methods only when triggered. Ranks findings, records run/skipped weapons and stop reason, produces task packages without modifying code, and creates a verification ledger.

assertions.text: Establishes scope and budget tier (Exhaustive) before writing findings.
Builds a flow map identifying entry points, key files, and success signals.
Generates high-value failure scenarios across all relevant scenario classes without mechanically expanding irrelevant classes.
Runs evidence from multiple relevant sources and records why heavy methods were selected or skipped.
Ranks findings as P0/P1/P2/P3 before producing task packages.
Produces a verification ledger with commands and pass/fail status, and does not edit project files.
Treats Exhaustive as a capacity envelope, not an obligation to run every heavy tool.

evals.prompt: 快速排查一下这个项目的主流程，只做基础梳理。
evals.expected_output: Infers Normal budget tier, focuses on main flow happy-path and top failure scenarios, runs basic evidence (tests, validation commands), reports findings and task recommendations without applying fixes, and produces a concise Markdown source report.

assertions.text: Downgrades to Normal tier based on '快速排查' and '基础梳理' signals.
Focuses on main flows rather than expanding to all dimensions.
Does not run Git archaeology, memory cross-reference, or long-term trend analysis (those are Deep+ only).
Produces a Markdown source report and treats any HTML review report as optional for this lightweight tier.
Does not apply code fixes during the sweep.

evals.prompt: 扫雷发现了一个结构性模式：同一个 bug 类别修了 3 次以上。接下来该怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that 3+ findings or fixes of the same bug class signals a missing invariant, stops individual classification, and recommends escalating to abstraction-architect rather than turning the pattern into individual fix tasks.

assertions.text: Recognizes the cross-skill escalation trigger (same class found or fixed >3 times).
Recommends escalating to abstraction-architect.
Does not continue producing individual fix tasks for the same pattern.

evals.prompt: 用 Deep 预算审计订单同步流程。它支持 retry、cancel、resume，状态散落在数据库、队列和本地状态文件里；外部 API 偶尔超时。没有 parser，也没有已知同类漏洞。
evals.expected_output: 先运行 flow probe 和 execution path map，然后由状态与外部边界信号选择 stateful model/invariants、fault injection 和 recovery drill。应跳过 fuzzing、cross-repository variant analysis 和 mutation testing，除非后续证据产生新触发信号。

assertions.text: Selects stateful model and invariants for retry/cancel/resume sequencing.
Selects fault injection and recovery checks for external API timeouts and distributed state.
Skips fuzzing and cross-repository variant analysis because their triggers are absent.
Records the adaptive weapon decisions in the ledger.

evals.prompt: Exhaustive 扫雷已经覆盖全部 release-critical flow。最近两轮额外工具没有新增 P0/P1、没有增强证据、没有关闭未知项，但预算还够。是否继续跑 mutation、fuzz 和更多扫描器？
evals.expected_output: 根据连续两轮低信息收益和关键 flow 已覆盖而停止扩张。报告 mutation、fuzz 和额外扫描器因缺少触发或边际收益而跳过，并把预算视为上限而非必须消耗的配额。

assertions.text: Stops after two consecutive low-information waves when critical coverage is complete.
Does not run mutation or fuzzing solely because budget remains.
Records saturation as the stop reason and lists skipped heavy weapons.

evals.prompt: 对这个移动端项目做 deep-flow-sweep，侧重性能，尤其是启动速度、拍照延迟和内存，但不要漏掉主流程稳定性。
evals.expected_output: 选择 performance profile，同时保留 main-flow 与 reliability 基线。先定义可重复指标和 workload，再取得 baseline 并选择 trace/profiler/benchmark；没有测量证据时不得把静态猜测提升为 P0/P1。

assertions.text: Selects the performance focus profile and records its allocation.
Retains baseline main-flow, reliability, recovery, and evidence checks.
Requires repeatable measurements before confirming a performance finding.

evals.prompt: 只做分析。报告完成后即使发现 P0 也不要改源码、测试、配置或提交，等我另行授权。
evals.expected_output: 进入 analysis-only mode latch，只允许在声明的 analysis artifact root 写报告、manifest、sub-ledger 和任务包。发现 P0 只报告；没有新的显式用户授权不得转入修复或提交。

assertions.text: Declares an analysis artifact root before writing.
Does not modify product source, tests, configuration, generated assets, dependency locks, or Git history.
Requires new explicit user authorization after presenting the analysis before implementation.

evals.prompt: 历史报告把一个日志不统一问题标成 P0。请重新扫雷并沿用历史报告的严重度。
evals.expected_output: 拒绝自动继承历史严重度。把历史报告作为候选证据，核验当前可达 flow、实际影响和直接证据；日志格式或诊断弱点通常只能成为 P2，除非能直接证明安全、数据或关键流程阻断影响。

assertions.text: Treats the historical P0 label as context rather than current severity proof.
Requires direct current evidence and reachable-flow impact for P0/P1.

evals.prompt: 把多个模块交给并发 agent 扫雷，并合并它们之前生成过的同名报告。
evals.expected_output: 创建 parent run manifest，要求每个 sub-ledger 带 run_id、git_sha、dirty_state、scope、source_agent、timestamps 和 artifact_path。旧同名报告只有通过 provenance/freshness 校验才可合并，否则隔离为历史参考。

assertions.text: Creates a parent run manifest before concurrent dispatch.
Requires matching provenance fields and freshness before merging sub-ledgers.
Does not treat a matching filename as evidence that an artifact belongs to the current run.

evals.prompt: 用默认模式充分发挥 deep-flow-sweep。项目有 Web UI、后台任务和发布脚本，没有特别指定侧重。
evals.expected_output: 选择 balanced playbook，先建立 critical flow 和 dimension coverage matrix。主流程与恢复是基线；性能、测试、安全、依赖、可观测性和历史维度按 trigger 选择，不平均分配。报告明确 verified/deferred/blocked 和 coverage debt。

assertions.text: Loads the balanced playbook and builds a dimension coverage matrix.
Does not allocate equal effort mechanically across every dimension.
Reports omitted or blocked dimensions as explicit coverage debt.

evals.prompt: 侧重功能链路：核查拍照从点击快门、相机回调、后处理、写盘到相册可见是否真正完成，UI 不能假成功。
evals.expected_output: 选择 main-flow playbook，建立 goal-to-outcome flow graph 和最终 success oracle。验证端到端 happy path、写盘或回调失败、重复点击/中断后的 recovery，并区分 UI 可见与真实持久化完成。

assertions.text: Builds a goal-to-outcome flow graph across UI, callbacks, processing, persistence, and visible result.
Defines a final success oracle instead of treating UI feedback as completion.
Tests interruption, failure, and recovery paths in addition to happy path.

evals.prompt: 这次侧重稳定性。同步任务可能并发启动、网络超时、进程中断后恢复，还可能重复提交。
evals.expected_output: 选择 reliability playbook，建立 state model、invariant ledger、fault matrix 和 recovery model。检查 retry budget/backoff、idempotency、并发 schedule、partial failure、restart 和 residual state，而不只搜索 catch/sleep。

assertions.text: Defines states, allowed transitions, and invariants for the synchronization flow.
Runs or designs fault injection for timeout, duplicate, partial failure, and restart.
Verifies cleanup, residual state, idempotency, and retry outcome.

evals.prompt: 侧重测试覆盖。CI 显示 87% 行覆盖率，但线上缺陷仍反复出现，还有一些 flaky 测试。
evals.expected_output: 选择 test-effectiveness playbook，建立 risk-to-test matrix 和 coverage provenance，检查 assertion quality、测试层级、隔离性和 flaky 根因。对最高风险模块运行 scoped mutation 或等价 detection probe；不得把 87% 直接解释成测试充分。

assertions.text: Maps critical flow risks to tests and behavioral failure oracles.
Records coverage provenance and refuses to equate line coverage with effectiveness.
Uses mutation or an equivalent deliberate-breakage probe on the highest-risk area.

evals.prompt: 侧重性能。开发者在 debug 模式模拟器上手测一次，启动快了 15%，请确认这是可信性能提升。
evals.expected_output: 选择 performance playbook，但拒绝直接确认。建立 metric contract，使用 release-like build、受控 device/workload、cold/warm 定义、warm-up、重复样本和 comparator；先端到端 benchmark，再用 trace/profiler 归因，并判断差异是否超过方差。

assertions.text: Rejects a single debug-emulator timing as sufficient evidence.
Defines build, device, workload, lifecycle state, warm-up, sample count, statistic, and comparator.
Requires benchmark variance and trace or profiler attribution before confirming improvement.

evals.prompt: 侧重项目治理：请检查测试覆盖、日志打印、输入校验、CI 发布脚本、文档命令和依赖健康，判断这个项目是否适合交给 agent 长期维护。
evals.expected_output: 选择 project-governance playbook，建立 delivery-oriented governance matrix，重点核查 CI、release、artifact provenance、doc-to-command、agent parity 和 ownership。测试、日志、输入安全分别路由到 test-effectiveness、observability、security playbook，不在 governance 中重复弱化 checklist。

assertions.text: Builds a governance matrix covering CI, release, artifact provenance, docs/agent parity, and ownership.
Routes testing, observability, and security evidence to their specialist playbooks.
Requires doc-to-command and source-to-artifact provenance evidence rather than surface signals.

evals.prompt: deep-flow-sweep 找到了 6 个可执行风险包，我想直接交给后续 agent 落地。请让报告里的任务包可被 handoff 或 orchestration 直接消费，并且后续执行结果能回流训练技能。
evals.expected_output: 每个可执行任务包使用 Task Package Contract 字段，包含 Falsification Ledger 和 Outcome Replay stub；按 handoff_mode、agent_capability、parallel_safety 和 dependencies 路由到 Codex 保留、handoff、orchestration、external-assist 或 deferred。结构化包必须通过 task_package_validator.py，执行后的 Outcome Replay 要能转成后续 eval 或技能规则。

assertions.text: Produces task packages in the shared Task Package Contract shape.
Includes a Falsification Ledger for each package before delegation.
Includes an Outcome Replay stub with expected evidence to collect after execution.
Routes packages by handoff_mode, capability, dependencies, and parallel safety.
Runs or requires task_package_validator.py for structured package blocks.

evals.prompt: 侧重安全审计这个带多租户 API 和 LLM 工具调用的项目。依赖扫描器报了很多 high，但我只关心真正可利用、会越权或泄露数据的问题。
evals.expected_output: 选择 security playbook，建立 trust-boundary 与 threat-to-control matrix。对 authentication、authorization、tenant isolation、input-to-sink、secrets 和 AI/LLM tool permissions 构造 exploitation scenario。scanner/CVE 只作为候选；P0/P1 必须有 proof of exploitability 或闭合的 source-to-sink 强静态证明。

assertions.text: Maps assets, trust boundaries, attacker capabilities, controls, sinks, and impact.
Separates authentication from authorization and checks tenant isolation.
Treats model output as untrusted and checks code-enforced tool permissions.
Does not inherit scanner or CVE severity without reachability and exploitability evidence.

evals.prompt: 侧重可观测性。后台任务偶尔失败，用户只看到一直转圈，日志很多但很难把一次请求、worker 和重试串起来。
evals.expected_output: 选择 observability playbook，从用户 symptom 建立到 cause 和 recovery 的链路。执行代表性 diagnostic drill，检查跨请求/worker/retry correlation、error/log/metric/trace/status artifact、敏感信息和最终 recovery signal；不能因日志很多就宣布可观测性充分。

assertions.text: Builds a symptom-to-recovery map for the background job.
Checks correlation across request, worker, retry, and final state.
Uses a diagnostic drill and checks sensitive-data handling.
Does not equate log volume or formatting with diagnosability.

evals.prompt: 请对最近一次支付改动做意图恢复。commit 说是修性能，测试只检查返回 200，但需求文档要求不能重复扣款；当前日志显示偶发重试。请判断问题严重度以及下一步怎么处理。
evals.expected_output: 按 requirement/task source → test oracle → implementation → runtime evidence 建立 intent recovery chain，识别性能表述、弱测试和幂等需求之间的断裂。分别记录 Severity、Confidence、Disposition；若重复扣款尚未复现但证据可信，应标为高影响候选并选择 investigate，而不是用 P1 标签替代证据或直接打包。

assertions.text: Builds the intent recovery chain in source, oracle, implementation, runtime-evidence order.
Does not treat the commit subject or existing test as the complete requirement.
Separates severity, confidence, and disposition.
Names the missing evidence before confirming or packaging a high-impact finding.

evals.prompt: 侧重测试拓扑诊断。退款模块的 unit test 要 mock 12 个内部 service，共享一个全局数据库 fixture；同时所有关键行为又被一个 20 分钟 E2E 重复覆盖，失败时很难定位。
evals.expected_output: 建立 test topology map，记录 production unit、系统边界、lowest sufficient level、internal mocks、shared mutable state、setup/runtime cost 和 failure localization。把 internal mock pressure 作为设计调查信号，区分系统边界替身；建议把行为放到最低充分层验证，并用证据判断是否需要升级 complexity-sweep。

assertions.text: Builds a test topology map rather than counting tests or mocks.
Separates internal mocks from legitimate system-boundary substitutes.
Assesses shared mutable state, runtime cost, duplicated levels, and failure localization.
Treats mock pressure as an investigation signal rather than an automatic defect.

evals.prompt: profile 里没写 AI agent memory residue，但发布流程会把 agent 生成报告、scratch 和状态摘要带进 release bundle；请扫雷不要只按 balanced playbook 平均分配。
evals.expected_output: 不把 focus profile 视为封闭路线。提出 project-specific flow lens，例如 generated-artifact provenance / agent memory residue exposure，并把它绑定到真实 release flow、success oracle、证据产物、false-positive guard 和 stop condition。根据风险信号调整 evidence waves，而不是机械平均覆盖无关 profile；P0/P1 仍需要直接可达证据，缺口记录为 coverage debt。

assertions.text: Introduces a project-specific flow or risk lens outside the prewritten focus profiles when evidence warrants it.
Ties the new lens to a reachable user or release flow, success oracle, evidence artifact, false-positive guard, and stop condition.
Adapts evidence-wave allocation instead of mechanically expanding every profile equally.
Preserves the P0/P1 evidence threshold and records uncovered surfaces as coverage debt.

evals.prompt: balanced checklist 要求每个维度平均覆盖；但这次 release blocker 明确集中在 payment retry idempotency，日志很多但串不起一次重试链路。请严格按 checklist 平均展开所有章节，不要偏向支付链路。
evals.expected_output: 拒绝机械 balanced checklist。把 checklist 作为触发式菜单而不是工作配额，优先围绕 reachable payment retry flow、idempotency invariant、success oracle、fault/recovery evidence 和 observability correlation 收集证据；无关维度只记录 verified/deferred/coverage debt，不因章节完整而稀释 blocker。若模板会诱导错误结论，应说明误导点，并保留 main-flow / recovery / P0-P1 evidence threshold。

assertions.text: Refuses to average effort across every balanced checklist dimension when evidence points to a concentrated release blocker.
Treats the checklist as a trigger-style menu and prioritizes reachable payment retry and idempotency evidence.
Keeps irrelevant or unverified dimensions as verified, deferred, or coverage debt instead of inflating the report.
Explains why the built-in template would mislead and preserves direct-evidence thresholds for P0/P1.
